'''Ms. Daisy''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game.

==Debut Appearance==
As an NPC character, Ms. Daisy first appears in the Festive Event, [[A Colorful Hunt]].

==History==
Ms. Daisy greets {{c|Carrol}} in the beginning sequence of A Colorful Hunt. She is not known to appear in the events that follow.

==Trivia==
*Despite appearing in A Colorful Hunt, Ms. Daisy does not have any artwork.
